Verifies that range(field) on a BritishCutoverDate returns the correct min/max bounds. This is particularly important for the cutover year 1752, where September has only 19 days (but range() still reports 1-30 as the structural range), the year has only 355 days, and aligned weeks are reduced accordingly.
